items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: And he was in that group that we played the battle of music with the McKinney's Cotton Pickers Kenny Scott in Detroit, and we also went to New York at the Savoy... And Shelton was great, and the band that we played against there was the great Chick Webb and Ella Fitzgerald

ctx.x: Yes. She went to Europe, and was quite successful there. She was the girl that outsang Ella Fitzgerald on "Tisket-a-Tasket" with that 5,000 people in the Savoy Ballroom in Chicago.
What do you mean she outsang her? She --
